visualCharacteristics.purpose: featured article teaser pairing a large image with a text panel
visualCharacteristics.description: Featured article: Fixed-width; large image on left (~60%), light grey (#ebebeb-ish) text panel on right with eyebrow 'Featured Article', h2, paragraph, yellow CTA. Grey belongs to the block panel; section background white.

contentPattern.structure: one row, two columns; column 1 = image, column 2 = eyebrow paragraph, h2, description and CTA link

cells.name: column 2
cells.content: eyebrow paragraph 'Featured Article', h2, description, CTA link

usage: Home page 'Featured Article' teaser (https://wknd.site/us/en.html): Camping in Western Australia.
reuseGuidance: Use for a single image-plus-text teaser where the image sits beside a shaded text panel on desktop and stacks above it on mobile. Text column holds the column cells (text, title, button).
